_comment: Curated names: {scope function: {old name: new name}}. Names declared in the scope rename that binding; otherwise free names (upN) inside the scope are renamed. `_proto` marks the decompiler's standalone copy of a closure that also appears inline under the plain name.
_skip_comment: Functions left alone by every rule, manual or automatic: they exist to evade detection or to protect the script (Luarmor heartbeat and tamper checks, the script's own authentication, the user-server auth codec, the Sentry client that sends script_key, call-stack and tostring tamper checks, game anti-cheat bypass and integrity scan, moderator detector, the aim humanizer that makes flicks look like human mouse movement). Copies of the same code elsewhere in the file are listed too. `fN^` entries skip the anonymous function around fN: the loader's bytecode deserializer closures that run with its hook audits (checkclosure / iscclosure).

f1518._comment: Left unnamed on purpose: the game anti-cheat bypass / integrity scan (f1523, f1527, f1529, f1531-f1546) and the moderator detector (f1560-f1633, including its ModDetector class), since both exist to evade detection.
